description:
Elevate your coastal living experience on the Costa del Sol with this exceptional development comprising luxury frontline beach apartments for sale in Manilva with onsite amenities. This exclusive project integrates cutting-edge architecture with the raw beauty of Andalusia, offering a unique lifestyle in a breathtaking setting.

Explore a selection of 2 to 4-bedroom frontline apartments and penthouses, each designed with spacious layouts and private terraces that provide sweeping views of the Mediterranean. From sunrise to sunset, immerse yourself in a backdrop where modern comfort meets the tranquillity of the sea and the natural world.

For those seeking ultimate privacy and serenity, the development also features opulent villas adjacent to a protected nature reserve. These villas offer a peaceful sanctuary, ideal for those who value both contemporary living and the soothing presence of nature, all while enjoying spectacular sea views.

Every detail of the shared spaces has been carefully designed to enhance your daily life. Swim in the stunning pool, enjoy the lush gardens, or unwind in comfortable lounging areas. The amenities are designed to create an atmosphere where relaxation and luxury go hand in hand. Designed with exceptional quality and meticulous attention to detail, this development offers a variety of living spaces to suit different preferences. Whether you are drawn to the elegance of a frontline apartment or the privacy of a nature-surrounded villa, you will discover a home that reflects your lifestyle and desires.

The location is spectacular, situated on the Mediterranean shores, offering a picturesque coastal lifestyle. Ideally positioned between Estepona, known for its charming old town and beaches, and Sotogrande, famous for its luxury marina, golf courses, and polo fields. Marbella, Puerto Banus, and Gibraltar are all within easy reach, offering upscale amenities, while Malaga International Airport is just an hour away. This prime setting seamlessly combines serene seafront living with proximity to prestigious coastal attractions and international connections.

Embrace the ultimate coastal lifestyle in this unmatched location—where luxury, tranquillity, and convenience meet. Contact us today to make one of these beachside apartments your new home.
